name: OpenRegister
summary: German company data from the Handelsregister, Bundesanzeiger, Transparenzregister and insolvency notices: company search, register details, owners, UBOs, holdings, financials, contacts, people and insolvency proceedings.

api_key.description: An OpenRegister API key (openregister.de/keys). Sent as a Bearer token.

notes: Credits per call: autocomplete 1; company, owners, holdings, financials, contact, person, searches and insolvency 10; UBO and historical owners 25; realtime=true adds 10. The free plan has 500 credits a month; 402 means out of credits.
Company ids look like DE-HRB-F1103-267645; get them from a search or autocomplete first.
Monitors, Transparenzregister credential storage and extract orders, and background jobs are not in this entry.

endpoints.name: Autocomplete German companies
endpoints.summary: Companies whose current or former name matches, with id, name and register details.

endpoints.name: Search German companies
endpoints.summary: Companies matching a text query and up to 70+ field filters: status, legal form, register, city, postcode, industry, incorporation date, financial figures, ownership traits, insolvency, LEI or VAT id, or a radius.

filters.description: A list of filters, ANDed: each {"field": ..., and one of "value", "values" (any of), "keywords" or "min"/"max"}; dates YYYY-MM-DD. Fields include status, legal_form, register_court, register_type, city, zip, active, incorporated_at, revenue, employees, balance_sheet_total, estimated_revenue (cents), estimated_employees, youngest_owner_age, has_open_insolvency, lei, vat_id; see the filtering guide.

notes: A read sent as POST with a JSON body: it searches and changes nothing. 10 credits per search.
Estimated revenue and EBITDA filters are in cents. The value, values, keywords and min/max forms are mutually exclusive within one filter.

export.description: true to return the company without sources.

endpoints.name: Search insolvency proceedings
endpoints.summary: German insolvency proceedings for companies and individuals by debtor, case number, administrator or court text, plus status, kind, court, city and date filters.

query.description: Text search: {"value": "..."}; matches debtor name, case number, administrator and court.

filters.description: A list of filters, ANDed: each {"field": ..., and one of "value", "values" (any of), "keywords" or "min"/"max"}; dates YYYY-MM-DD. Fields: debtor_kind, debtor_legal_form, court, city, current_status, has_open_insolvency, proceeding_kind, administration_kind, insolvency_grounds, opened_at, closed_at, last_event_at, claims_filing_deadline, company_id, person_id.

notes: A read sent as POST with a JSON body. 10 credits per search.
